The time between matches can affect rest, especially during periods with league and continental tournament commitments. Even so, these factors cannot be turned into certainty: coaches may change their plans, players may return, and the pace of the game may defy expectations. [...] A match should not be assessed solely by the teams' positions in the standings or the clubs' reputations. The context includes home advantage, recent form, confirmed absences, schedule, playing style, and the importance of the matchup. These factors help provide a more complete picture, but none of them determines the result.
